# 2 Baruch Chapter 38 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**38:1** And he answered and said to me: This also I will explain to you, and everything that you have asked I will explain to you, because you have been found worthy to receive these things.

**38:2** For many have heard, but few have been shown; and one in a generation has understood.

**38:3** Therefore it will be as I have said: the interpretation of this vision will be given to you.

**38:4** And the most excellent law of the Most High, which will not pass away or be moved, will judge those who are found worthy of it.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "most excellent law" (v.4) over EMET's "most-perfect-[law]" — LOGOS's "most excellent" is more natural English; "not pass away or be moved" (v.4) retained as a pair — both terms are present in the Syriac; "one in a generation has understood" (v.2) is a remarkable claim about esoteric transmission that all three preserve.*
